From 062ea905fff7756b2e87143ffccaece5cdb44267 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Mario Limonciello <mario.limonciello@amd.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 14:07:40 -0600
Subject: [PATCH] drm/amd: Fix NULL pointer dereference in device cleanup

When GPU initialization fails due to an unsupported HW block
IP blocks may have a NULL version pointer. During cleanup in
amdgpu_device_fini_hw, the code calls amdgpu_device_set_pg_state and
amdgpu_device_set_cg_state which iterate over all IP blocks and access
adev->ip_blocks[i].version without NULL checks, leading to a kernel
NULL pointer dereference.

Add NULL checks for adev->ip_blocks[i].version in both
amdgpu_device_set_cg_state and amdgpu_device_set_pg_state to prevent
dereferencing NULL pointers during GPU teardown when initialization has
failed.

Fixes: 39fc2bc4da00 ("drm/amdgpu: Protect GPU register accesses in powergated state in some paths")
Reviewed-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Mario Limonciello <mario.limonciello@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
(cherry picked from commit b7ac77468cda92eecae560b05f62f997a12fe2f2)
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_device.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_device.c
index 3e19b51a2763..10b10bac8b18 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_device.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_device.c
@@ -3247,6 +3247,8 @@ int amdgpu_device_set_cg_state(struct amdgpu_device *adev,
 		i = state == AMD_CG_STATE_GATE ? j : adev->num_ip_blocks - j - 1;
 		if (!adev->ip_blocks[i].status.late_initialized)
 			continue;
+		if (!adev->ip_blocks[i].version)
+			continue;
 		/* skip CG for GFX, SDMA on S0ix */
 		if (adev->in_s0ix &&
 		    (adev->ip_blocks[i].version->type == AMD_IP_BLOCK_TYPE_GFX ||
@@ -3286,6 +3288,8 @@ int amdgpu_device_set_pg_state(struct amdgpu_device *adev,
 		i = state == AMD_PG_STATE_GATE ? j : adev->num_ip_blocks - j - 1;
 		if (!adev->ip_blocks[i].status.late_initialized)
 			continue;
+		if (!adev->ip_blocks[i].version)
+			continue;
 		/* skip PG for GFX, SDMA on S0ix */
 		if (adev->in_s0ix &&
 		    (adev->ip_blocks[i].version->type == AMD_IP_BLOCK_TYPE_GFX ||
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of the Patch

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_device.c`**

1. **`amdgpu_device_set_cg_state()` function** (line ~3247):
   - Added a NULL check for `adev->ip_blocks[i].version` before using the `version` pointer.
   - If the version is NULL, the function continues to the next IP block.

2. **`amdgpu_device_set_pg_state()` function** (line ~3286):
   - Added an identical NULL check for `adev->ip_blocks[i].version` before using the `version` pointer.
   - If the version is NULL, the function continues to the next IP block.

### Relationship Between the Modifications

Both changes address the same underlying issue: during GPU device cleanup (when hardware initialization fails due to unsupported blocks), some IP blocks may have a NULL `version` pointer. The original code unconditionally dereferenced `adev->ip_blocks[i].version` in both `amdgpu_device_set_cg_state()` and `amdgpu_device_set_pg_state()`, leading to a kernel NULL pointer dereference.

The fix applies an identical defensive check in both functions, ensuring they safely skip blocks with a NULL version pointer before attempting to access any version-related fields. The two modifications are logically paired—they are separate instances of the same bug pattern and are resolved with the same fix.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:  
```
if (adev->ip_blocks[i].version->type == AMD_IP_BLOCK_TYPE_GFX || ...)
```
from `amdgpu_device_set_cg_state`, and  
```
if (adev->ip_blocks[i].version->type == AMD_IP_BLOCK_TYPE_GFX || ...)
```
from `amdgpu_device_set_pg_state`.  

Reason:  
During GPU initialization failure (e.g., due to an unsupported HW block), some IP blocks may have a NULL `version` pointer. The cleanup functions `amdgpu_device_set_cg_state` and `amdgpu_device_set_pg_state` iterate over all IP blocks and access `adev->ip_blocks[i].version` (e.g., reading `version->type`) without a NULL check. This causes a kernel NULL pointer dereference when `version` is NULL.

The code statements that fix the bug are:  
```
+		if (!adev->ip_blocks[i].version)
+			continue;
```
added in both `amdgpu_device_set_cg_state` and `amdgpu_device_set_pg_state`.  

Reason:  
The added NULL check immediately skips any IP block whose `version` pointer is NULL, preventing the subsequent dereference of `version->type` or `version->funcs`. This avoids the NULL pointer dereference during device teardown when initialization has failed.
